summary.text: Vanna Howard is a Democratic state senator representing the 1st Middlesex District, a seat she won in a March 3, 2026 special election, and she is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot seeking a full term.
She previously served in the Massachusetts House of Representatives from 2021 to 2026 and has worked as a nonprofit executive.

paragraphs.text: Vanna Howard studied at Revere High School, Middlesex Community College, the University of Massachusetts, and Harvard Business School.

Her career experience includes working as chief of external relations at the Lowell Community Health Center, as Greater Lowell regional director for former U.S. Representative Niki Tsongas, and with the Middlesex and Suffolk County District Attorney's Offices.

Ballotpedia lists her affiliations as including the Cambodian Mutual Assistance Association, Mill City Grows, the Boys and Girls Club of Greater Lowell, the Lowell Housing Authority and the American Red Cross.
Howard represented the 17th Middlesex District in the Massachusetts House of Representatives from 2021 to 2026, succeeding David Nangle.

In the 2025-2026 session she was assigned to the House Ways and Means Committee and to joint committees on Community Development and Small Businesses, Higher Education, Racial Equity, Civil Rights, and Inclusion, and Ways and Means.

She won the special general election for the 1st Middlesex District Senate seat on March 3, 2026, assumed office on March 18, 2026, and advanced from the September 1, 2026 Democratic primary; Ballotpedia lists Republican Sam Meas and Joseph Espinola III (Unenrolled) as the other general election candidates.
